assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery alongside nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current management strategies.
Diagnosis codes I25.10, I34.0, and R00.2 support the medical necessity of the service.
The CO-22 denial code is present.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22.
The patient has a right to appeal the determination.
